WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-04-28' AS start_date, DATE '2026-05-03' AS end_date   -- FY2025/26, 53 weeks
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS control_net_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE c.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND c.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.sqm, ss.net_sales, ct.control_net_sales, ss.net_sales - ct.control_net_sales AS gap
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctrl ct ON ct.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 15

WITH nl AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), a AS (SELECT d, SUM(v) AS q FROM nl WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.d, a.q, c.net_sales AS control, a.q - c.net_sales AS gap
FROM a FULL JOIN (SELECT business_date, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 116 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03') c ON c.business_date = a.d
WHERE abs(coalesce(a.q,0) - coalesce(c.net_sales,0)) > 0.005
ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS ids, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT n, ids, count(*) AS keys, sum(net) AS net, min(first_load) AS fl, max(last_load) AS ll FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT s.store_id, min(f.sale_date) AS first_date, max(f.sale_date) AS last_date, count(*) AS dup_rows, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_in_dup_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-04-28' AS start_date, DATE '2026-05-03' AS end_date
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id) AS rn
        FROM fact_sales_line f
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ss.net_sales
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 10
